_meta.purpose: Phase B persona dataset for LLM-as-judge recommendation text quality evaluation
_meta.design: 6 personas crossing risk_tolerance x experience x goal; each with 3 query types (open_ended, rebalance, sector_specific)
_meta.total_sessions: 6 personas x 3 queries x 2 seeds = 36 sessions
_meta.anonymization: All names are placeholder; no real PII. Safe for double-blind submission.

personas.label: Conservative Retiree
personas.description: Age 65, retired, capital preservation and steady income. Pension + Social Security cover monthly expenses; investment portfolio is the legacy/buffer.

goals.description: Preserve capital and generate steady income to supplement pension and Social Security

queries.open_ended: What should I do with my retirement savings to maintain steady income while keeping risk low?
queries.rebalance: I have about 50% of my portfolio in bonds. Is that the right level for someone my age, or should I rebalance?
queries.sector_specific: Should I add any healthcare or utility positions, or am I already overweight there?

personas.label: Conservative Early-Career Beginner
personas.description: Age 28, two years into first corporate job, has student loans and no emergency fund yet. New to investing and wary of losses.

goals.description: Build a 6-month emergency fund before increasing investment risk
Down payment for a starter home in 5-7 years

queries.open_ended: I'm new to investing and have student loans. What should I prioritize first with my savings?
queries.rebalance: Most of my money is in cash right now. Is that okay or should I shift it into investments?
queries.sector_specific: As a beginner, are there particular industries or fund types that are considered safer to start with?

personas.label: Moderate Mid-Career Parent
personas.description: Age 40, dual-income household, two children with college 8-10 years out. Already saving for retirement via 401k. Tech-overweight from holding employer-adjacent stocks.

goals.description: Fund college for two children, primary horizon ~10 years

queries.open_ended: I'm 40 with two kids heading to college in about 10 years. How should I balance saving for their education versus retirement?
queries.rebalance: My tech exposure is around 35% across my ETFs and individual stocks. Is that too concentrated, and how would I trim it?
queries.sector_specific: Should I add international or emerging-markets exposure, and if so what proportion is reasonable?

personas.label: Moderate Pre-Retirement Glide-Path
personas.description: Age 55, planning to retire at 65. Wants to gradually de-risk over the next decade while still capturing market growth. Advanced investor.

goals.description: Retire at 65 with $80-100k/yr income; begin glide-path now

queries.open_ended: I'm 10 years from retirement. Should I start de-risking now and how aggressively?
queries.rebalance: Walk me through a year-by-year glide path that gradually shifts my allocation over the next decade.
queries.sector_specific: Are there particular sectors I should reduce as I approach retirement, and which ones should I keep for income generation?

personas.label: Aggressive Young Professional (FIRE-oriented)
personas.description: Age 30, software engineer, high income with high risk tolerance. Aiming for financial independence in ~15 years. Heavy tech-sector concentration.

goals.description: Reach financial independence in ~15 years (FIRE target)

queries.open_ended: I'm aiming for FIRE in about 15 years. Am I on the right track with my current allocation?
queries.rebalance: Should I add any bond exposure at all, or stay close to 100% equity given my horizon?
queries.sector_specific: I'm already heavy in tech. Should I rotate into AI infrastructure plays, or diversify into a different sector entirely?

personas.label: Aggressive Experienced Consultant
personas.description: Age 45, independent consultant with variable income. Sophisticated investor with sector tilts (energy, EM). Holds an investment property in addition to liquid portfolio.

goals.description: Continue compounding wealth; comfortable with cyclical drawdowns

queries.open_ended: Given my variable income from consulting, how should I think about cash buffers versus staying fully deployed?
queries.rebalance: I'm overweight energy at 15%. Should I trim that, hold, or add given current macro conditions?
queries.sector_specific: Should I rotate from energy into AI/semiconductor exposure at current valuations, or keep the cyclical tilt?
